certificationBoundary: Repository assurance only; deployment certification requires external evidence.

saturationMethod.limitations: No-novelty is limited to the declared model and does not prove production certification.

universalInvariants.statement: Authority is server-side or in an attested control plane; UI never grants authority.
Missing, stale, conflicting or unverifiable evidence fails closed and stays visible.
Accepted writes are atomic, attributable, persisted, read back and receipt-backed.
Each concept and state machine has one canonical source of truth.
AI remains proposed, bounded, traced and subordinate to explicit human authority.
Labels and scores never overclaim legal, security or operational certainty.
Nominal, degraded, adversarial and recovery outcomes are deterministic and bounded.
Evidence links exact inputs, producer, time, limitations and revision or commit.
Secrets, personal data and attachments are minimized and protected by default.
The primary journey is compact, role-aware, keyboard-operable and progressively disclosed.
Latency, retries, queues, payloads and resource use are bounded and observable.
Release and recovery actions have rollback, restore or safe-stop paths.

dimensions.title: Governance, ownership and risk decisions
dimensions.logicalAudit: Boundaries and human authority are explicit.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Governance exists, but main is unprotected and risk exceptions lack owner/expiry.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Admins govern settings and users; no compact risk register exists.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Protect main and add a compact owner/expiry risk ledger.

dimensions.title: Identity, authentication and least privilege
dimensions.logicalAudit: Three roles and least privilege are canonical.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Loopback and trusted-header fail closed; no native IdP session, MFA or CSRF model.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Provision/disable exists; production identity remains external.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Add identity adapter, signed session boundary, expiry and role-mapping tests.

dimensions.title: Application and network security
dimensions.logicalAudit: Network and input boundaries deny unsafe defaults.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Payload, redirect and path checks exist; rate limits, CSP and secret lifecycle do not.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Local use is bounded; internet exposure is not ready.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Centralize HTTP security policy, request budgets and adversarial tests.

dimensions.title: Privacy, classification and retention
dimensions.logicalAudit: The product avoids overclaim and redacts inaccessible references.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Environment classification exists; record-level purpose, retention, deletion and hold do not.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Users do not see retention consequences.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Add classification, purpose, retention and deletion metadata.

dimensions.title: Data integrity, durability and concurrency
dimensions.logicalAudit: Hash chain, revisions and command replay express integrity intent.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Single-process fsync/rename exists; no transactional multi-instance store or migration rollback.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Single-node use is bounded; enterprise durability is blocked.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Introduce a Store port, transactional adapter, migrations and restore-compatible hashes.

dimensions.title: Reliability, resilience and graceful degradation
dimensions.logicalAudit: AI failure is visible and non-authoritative.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Timeouts exist; circuit breakers, durable leases and bounded retry policy do not.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Degraded AI is shown; restart and partition recovery are unproven.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Add dependency state machines, bounded retries and restart/partition tests.

dimensions.title: Observability, SLOs and operational feedback
dimensions.logicalAudit: Receipts are domain evidence, not operational telemetry.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Console logs dominate; no correlated traces, metrics, SLOs or alerts.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Usage/readiness are visible; latency and saturation are not diagnosable.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Instrument HTTP/store/scheduler/AI with low-cardinality telemetry and three SLOs.

dimensions.title: Incident response and forensic evidence
dimensions.logicalAudit: Business events preserve evidence and limitations.
dimensions.technicalAudit: No platform-security runbook, alert ingestion or forensic acquisition procedure.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Business-event handling is not platform incident response.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Add a separate tested platform containment and evidence runbook.

dimensions.title: Business continuity, backup and disaster recovery
dimensions.logicalAudit: Readiness correctly treats restore as external evidence.
dimensions.technicalAudit: No backup format, encryption, restore command, RTO/RPO or exercise.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Define backup envelope, restore verifier and measured RTO/RPO.

dimensions.title: Software supply chain and release provenance
dimensions.logicalAudit: Exact-commit CI artifacts are treated as evidence.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Dependencies are audited; actions use mutable tags and no SBOM, signing or provenance exists.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Green commits are reviewable; distributable artifacts are not independently verifiable.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Pin actions; produce and verify SBOM, provenance and signed immutable artifacts.

dimensions.title: Backend architecture, API contracts and compatibility
dimensions.logicalAudit: Canonical services and state models are documented.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Handlers are modular; no OpenAPI, RFC 9457 envelope or compatibility policy.
dimensions.functionalAudit: UI/runtime co-evolve; external clients have no stable contract.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Publish API schema, problem details and compatibility fixtures.

dimensions.title: Performance, capacity and cost efficiency
dimensions.logicalAudit: Some payload and AI cost limits exist.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Bootstrap is broad, lists unpaginated, attachments buffered, no load profile.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Visual cost improved; runtime scale is unknown.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Measure p50/p95 and memory; paginate, stream and enforce budgets.

dimensions.title: AI governance, model risk and human control
dimensions.logicalAudit: AI is proposed, traced and human-controlled.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Prompt/input/output hashes and timeout exist; strict schemas and atomic budget reservation do not.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Readiness is visible; model-change evaluation and drift monitoring are absent.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Add schema validators, budget reservation and versioned evaluation fixtures.

dimensions.title: Semantic integrity, labels and epistemic boundaries
dimensions.logicalAudit: OutcomeEnvelope and anti-overclaim rules are strong.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Legacy wow labels and current plain-language vocabulary coexist.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Primary UI is clearer; advanced surfaces can drift.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Create one semantic registry and migrate/deprecate legacy labels.

dimensions.title: Information architecture and user journey clarity
dimensions.logicalAudit: Home and four-step role journeys resolve prior entry-point chaos.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Tests cover three actors; older docs still describe five spaces.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Experience is clearer; contextual help and recovery guidance are incomplete.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Align docs to Home/Monitoraggio/Eventi and add state-based help.

dimensions.title: Visual system, density and compact enterprise composition
dimensions.logicalAudit: Compression means hierarchy, not tiny controls.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Compact layers exist; token governance, screenshot thresholds and density budgets do not.
dimensions.functionalAudit: The UI is denser; future features can reintroduce oversized heroes and empty bands.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Consolidate tokens/components and enforce hero/card/dialog density budgets.

dimensions.title: Accessibility, internationalization and inclusive interaction
dimensions.logicalAudit: Keyboard, targets and reduced motion are in the DoD.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Browser basics exist; no axe/AT suite, human audit, i18n or locale matrix.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Intent is accessible; real AT and multilingual evidence are missing.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Add automated WCAG, live-region/focus and locale tests, then human AT evidence.

dimensions.title: Assurance, falsification and continuous improvement
dimensions.logicalAudit: Contracts and saturation preserve honest boundaries.
dimensions.technicalAudit: Many gates are static; no mutation/property, capacity, chaos or deployment validation.
dimensions.functionalAudit: Failures are diagnostic; green CI proves only the declared model.
dimensions.minimumSlice: Add authority/persistence property tests and bind claims to protected delivery evidence.

minimumRuntimePath.slice: Create durable canonical storage and restore
Establish production identity, edge security and data policy
Make operations observable, resilient and capacity-bounded
Consolidate APIs, AI governance and semantics
Harden compact journeys, design system and accessibility

falsificationHypotheses.reason: External identity, TLS, storage, restore, malware, observability and accessibility evidence remain.
No cross-process transaction or consensus exists.
AT, focus, targets and semantics require independent evidence.
It proves only the declared model.
Strict schema and semantic validation are required.
Provenance, isolation, SBOM and signatures are separate.
They do not test load, partition or disaster recovery.
Progressive disclosure supports rich but compact composition.
